description: GLSL shaders + Three.js postprocessing recipes. Each shader is a self-contained snippet ready to inject.

nebula.name: Nebula / Space Clouds
nebula.use_when: خلفية فضائية ملونة متحركة. مناسب لـ hero ثلاثي الأبعاد.
nebula.fragment_shader: precision highp float; uniform float u_time; uniform vec2 u_resolution; float hash(vec3 p){p=fract(p*0.3183099+0.1);p*=17.0;return fract(p.x*p.y*p.z*(p.x+p.y+p.z));} float noise(vec3 x){vec3 i=floor(x);vec3 f=fract(x);f=f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);return mix(mix(mix(hash(i+vec3(0,0,0)),hash(i+vec3(1,0,0)),f.x),mix(hash(i+vec3(0,1,0)),hash(i+vec3(1,1,0)),f.x),f.y),mix(mix(hash(i+vec3(0,0,1)),hash(i+vec3(1,0,1)),f.x),mix(hash(i+vec3(0,1,1)),hash(i+vec3(1,1,1)),f.x),f.y),f.z);} void main(){vec2 uv=(gl_FragCoord.xy-0.5*u_resolution.xy)/u_resolution.y;float t=u_time*0.05;float n=0.0;float amp=0.5;vec3 p=vec3(uv*2.0,t);for(int i=0;i<5;i++){n+=amp*noise(p);p*=2.0;amp*=0.5;}vec3 col1=vec3(0.05,0.0,0.2);vec3 col2=vec3(0.8,0.2,0.6);vec3 col3=vec3(0.0,0.7,1.0);vec3 col=mix(col1,col2,smoothstep(0.3,0.6,n));col=mix(col,col3,smoothstep(0.6,0.85,n));col+=vec3(1.0)*smoothstep(0.85,0.95,n);gl_FragColor=vec4(col,1.0);}

matrix_rain.name: Matrix Digital Rain
matrix_rain.js_snippet: function matrixRain(canvasId){const c=document.getElementById(canvasId);const ctx=c.getContext('2d');c.width=innerWidth;c.height=innerHeight;const cols=Math.floor(c.width/14);const ys=Array(cols).fill(0);const chars='0123456789ABCDEFアイウエオカキクケコ'.split('');function draw(){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.05)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);ctx.fillStyle='#00ff41';ctx.font='14px monospace';ys.forEach((y,i)=>{const t=chars[Math.floor(Math.random()*chars.length)];ctx.fillText(t,i*14,y);ys[i]=y>c.height||Math.random()>0.975?0:y+14;});}setInterval(draw,33);}

audio_visualizer.name: Audio Reactive Waveform
audio_visualizer.use_when: Music/podcast pages reacting to audio playback.
audio_visualizer.js_snippet: async function setupAudioViz(audioEl, canvasEl){const ctx=new(AudioContext||webkitAudioContext)();const src=ctx.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);const analyser=ctx.createAnalyser();analyser.fftSize=256;src.connect(analyser);analyser.connect(ctx.destination);const data=new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);const c=canvasEl.getContext('2d');function draw(){requestAnimationFrame(draw);analyser.getByteFrequencyData(data);c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';c.fillRect(0,0,canvasEl.width,canvasEl.height);const bw=canvasEl.width/data.length;data.forEach((v,i)=>{const h=v*canvasEl.height/255;const grad=c.createLinearGradient(0,canvasEl.height,0,canvasEl.height-h);grad.addColorStop(0,'#ff006e');grad.addColorStop(1,'#00f5ff');c.fillStyle=grad;c.fillRect(i*bw,canvasEl.height-h,bw-1,h);});}draw();}

particle_burst.name: Particle Burst on Click
particle_burst.use_when: Reward feedback on CTAs, gaming UI.
particle_burst.js_snippet: function particleBurst(x,y,color='#ff006e'){const n=30;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const p=document.createElement('div');p.style.cssText=`position:fixed;left:${x}px;top:${y}px;width:6px;height:6px;background:${color};border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;`;document.body.appendChild(p);const ang=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;const vel=2+Math.random()*4;const dx=Math.cos(ang)*vel;const dy=Math.sin(ang)*vel;p.animate([{transform:'translate(0,0) scale(1)',opacity:1},{transform:`translate(${dx*40}px,${dy*40}px) scale(0)`,opacity:0}],{duration:600+Math.random()*400,easing:'cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)',fill:'forwards'}).onfinish=()=>p.remove();}}

liquid_distortion.name: Liquid Distortion Hover
liquid_distortion.css_snippet:
.liquid { transition: clip-path 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 0.6s; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); }
.liquid:hover { clip-path: polygon(0 5%, 100% 0, 95% 100%, 5% 95%); transform: scale(1.02); }

film_grain.css_snippet:
.grain { position:relative; }
.grain::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; opacity:0.15; mix-blend-mode:overlay; background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='200' height='200'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/></filter><rect width='200' height='200' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>"); }
